chapter_title: Kathmandu & A House Is Not a Home
summary: Unit 8 serves as the concluding chapter of the Kaveri textbook, focusing on goal-setting, self-belief, and resilience. Formatted as an advisory letter from a mother to her graduating daughter, the text offers practical guidance on pursuing ambitions, understanding that long-term goals require discipline, adaptability, and perseverance through setbacks.

key_takeaways: Fulfilling dreams requires sustained effort, daily discipline, and quiet preparation.
A growth mindset views setbacks as diagnostic feedback rather than proof of failure.
SMART goal setting converts vague ambitions into structured, actionable achievements.
